card.name: Capital C or W starting a new term
card.fires_on: The first letter, usually C or W, of a name that begins right after a bracket, comma, quote or list break. Typical cases are drug and brand names (cimetidine, Cervidil, Citanest, Cetacaine) and the section reference Warnings.

modes.label: Drug or title starting with C
modes.description: A single C, capital or lowercase, opens a drug, brand or title name, and the rest of the name follows.

modes.label: Warnings cross-reference
modes.description: A capital W opens the word Warnings in a bracketed section reference.

card.plain: It fires on the first letter of a name, mostly C, as the name begins, such as a drug name or the start of a Warnings section reference.
